summary: Backend-only verification of the Milestone Celebration feature (challenge_unlocked realtime event + wallet credit on challenge unlock). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_challenge_unlock_celebration.py (pytest) covering: (1) auto_award_incentives credits wallet AND emits a challenge_unlocked event targeted at the partner with correct name/amount/bonus_amount/auto flags; (2) idempotency - second auto-award call for the same already-paid incentive does NOT re-credit the wallet and does NOT emit a duplicate event; (3) regression - _incentive_progress counts ONLY completion/completion_cos rows (cancellation, cancellation_cos, additional_work rows excluded); (4) regression - GET /api/partner/challenges and /api/partner/incentives return 200 with expected progress fields for seeded partner +919000000003. All 5 pytest cases pass. Also re-ran the two provided standalone scripts (challenge_unlock_event_test.py, challenge_count_test.py) - both pass. Cleanup fixtures delete all TAG='UNLOCKTEST' incentives/ledger/award rows after each test.
critical_code_review_comments: services/partner_service.py :: _credit_incentive_award correctly guards the realtime emit behind `if amount:` so idempotent re-runs (which return 0) will NOT emit a duplicate challenge_unlocked event. Verified end-to-end.

services/partner_service.py :: auto_award_incentives wraps the whole loop in a bare try/except that swallows ALL exceptions and returns []. This is intentional (never break booking flow) but it also masks any real emit/credit failure silently - consider at least logging the exception for observability.
services/partner_service.py is 2082 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting incentives/awards into their own module (partner_incentive_service.py). Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_challenge_unlock_celebration.py. The repo's pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope via required_plugins; run with `-n 0` for serial execution since the tests share module-scope state. Motor async client is bound to a module-level loop created BEFORE importing config.database (otherwise motor raises 'future belongs to a different loop'). Env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is NOT present in /app/frontend/.env (frontend is Expo) - set it inline: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 pytest tests/test_challenge_unlock_celebration.py -n 0`.
